Lena (AE): FYI Ellen from Midland Bank confirmed they need an on-prem, fully air-gapped POC for our inference platform. Key asks: secure courier delivery, signed SBOM, monthly security delta patches, and a clear rollback story.

Omar (SE): Good to know. Quick tech Qs: will the site accept USB HSM tokens or only networked HSMs? Also, do they want model variants included or a single curated model?

Ellen (Customer): We prefer USB HSM tokens for the POC (FIPS mode). Only one curated model to keep bundle size small.

Vik (Product Ops): We can assemble a "poc-light" bundle that strips telemetry, analytics, and nonessential CLI tools. Typical full bundle ~22GB; target POC bundle ~4-7GB depending on model precisions.

Nina (Security): Requirements for airgap: 1) Signed bundle (detached sig), 2) SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX), 3) reproducible build manifest, 4) chain-of-custody note for courier. Example verify command we expect customers to run on the airgapped host:

```
# verify checksum and signature
sha256sum -c redwood-bundle.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle.sha256
```

Tom (Legal): Commercial note: for monthly security deltas we need to include a maintenance schedule in the SOW. Also advise cap on emergency hotfix fees. Ellen - is your procurement OK with a fixed retainer + capped T&M for out-of-scope emergency fixes?

Ellen (Customer): Procurement prefers a capped monthly retainer that covers 2 emergency hotfixes per quarter, additional fixes billable but capped annually.

Lena (AE): Noted. We'll propose a retainer model with cap. Also, Ellen will you need notarized chain-of-custody documentation from the courier?

Ellen (Customer): Yes, we need signed COA (certificate of arrival) and tamper-evidence seal photos.

Omar (SE): On upgrades: delta patches are possible for small runtime/security fixes. They are binary diffs applied by installer. Constraints: deltas must not change model quantization or major runtime ABI. If quantization changes are required, we do a full bundle release. Rollback: we support rollback to the immediate previous bundle only (single-step).

Vik (Product Ops): Operational detail: for every delta we produce a delta-manifest.json and a signed checkpoint that indicates base bundle hash and target hash. Customers must keep the previous bundle as the rollback artifact. We will include a small rollback helper script.

Nina (Security): Vulnerability timeline proposal: initial advisory within 48 hours for critical issues, mitigation guidance in 5 business days, and code/model patch within 30 calendar days when feasible. We can include SLA exceptions for third-party model library issues.

Ellen (Customer): 48h advisory is good. Also need SBOM for all runtime libs and a build-attestation showing exact build environment (container image + toolchain hash).

Vik (Product Ops): We can export CycloneDX SBOM and a signed attestation artifact. Lead time: if we use a standard curated model + runtime, artifacts ready in 48 hours. If we need a custom quantization pass add 4 business days.

Tom (Legal): Another item: escrow access for emergency hotfixes in the event Redwood is unavailable. We offer a limited escrow for critical patching under strict conditions; we'll draft language.

Omar (SE): HSM integration: we support PKCS#11 and can accept USB tokens (Yubikey-like or Luna eToken). We'll need vendor and firmware details to validate. Offline key import flow: operator runs `pkcs11-tool --login --module /usr/lib/libykcs11.so` to provision keys.

Ellen (Customer): We'll supply Thales Luna eToken vendor + firmware and arrange a test device for validation.

artifact-bot: airgap-artifact-job queued for poc-light-1716234567, status=queued

Lena (AE): Action list: 1) Omar/Vik: build poc-light bundle (target 6GB) + SBOM + attestation + delta-manifest template; 2) Nina: draft airgap security questionnaire answers + vuln SLA; 3) Tom: SOW draft with retainer + emergency cap + escrow clause; 4) Ellen: courier COA requirements + HSM firmware details.

Omar (SE): I'll start the build and request a quantization-free build to avoid full-bundle changes later. ETA artifacts: 3 business days.

Ellen (Customer): Please include a dry-run checklist so our ops can rehearse the install.

Vik (Product Ops): Will do — dry-run checklist will include verification commands, import key steps, smoke tests (inference sanity, latency probe), and rollback drill.

Lena (AE): Great — planning a 60-90min dry run the week after artifacts are ready. I'll send calendar invites once build job completes. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
